news.headline: PSX extends losses on political uncertainty - added sector/stock detail for Thu Aug 20 confirmed close
news.summary: Supplements the already-logged Thu Aug 20, 2026 confirmed close (176,591.77, down 254.59pts/-0.14%, volatile session). Per Dawn.com, late nervous selling was attributed to political uncertainty and Middle East tensions; intraday index surged over 1,400 points to 178,291.37 before retreating to a low of 176,156.57. New detail not previously captured: United Bank (UBL), Hub Power (HUBC), Bank Al Habib (BAFL), Habib Bank (HBL) and Fatima Fertiliser (FATIMA) collectively removed ~458 points from the benchmark; OGDC, Engro Holdings (ENGROH) and Sazgar Engineering (SAZEW) collectively contributed ~321 points. Volume down 15.57% to 665m shares; traded value down 22.17% to Rs30.8bn. Market faced resistance at the 178,000-180,000 zone. Tagged to the union of the superseded MACRO-only close entry plus tickers newly named in this source, per the confirmed-close supersession rule. Sub-1% net move; impact 3 (notable), consistent with prior similar-magnitude index-close entries.

news.summary: Rehmat Ali Hasnie's tenure as President and CEO of National Bank of Pakistan (PSX: NBP) expired effective August 21, 2026, per Mettis Global / an official company statement. No successor named or interim-arrangement detail disclosed in the source reviewed this cycle. Logged as impact 3 (notable management change) per desk news-impact criteria (Rule 10).

news.headline: Symmetry Group (SYM) deploys Rs325.4m of Rs361.5m net IPO proceeds
news.summary: Symmetry Group Limited (PSX: SYM) reported in its final progress report on IPO-proceeds utilization that it has deployed Rs325.4m of its Rs361.5m net IPO proceeds against approved allocations, with the remaining ~Rs36.1m absorbed into working capital, per Mettis Global. Logged as impact 2 (minor company administrative/financial item).

news.summary: Pakistan's Sensitive Price Indicator (SPI), a weekly short-term inflation gauge, increased 0.49% for the week ended August 20, 2026, per Mettis Global. No item-level breakdown or YoY comparison captured this cycle. Logged as impact 2 (minor, routine weekly economic print; not a material single move).

news.headline: Govt increases petrol by 27 paisas, HSD by Rs1.64 for Aug 21
news.summary: Per The Express Tribune, effective Aug 21, 2026 the government made a small daily fuel-price adjustment under the new daily-pricing mechanism (introduced Aug 20 amid geopolitical price volatility): petrol up Rs0.27/litre to Rs337.78/litre; High-Speed Diesel (HSD) up Rs1.64/litre to Rs364.70/litre. This follows the already-logged Aug 20 move (petrol +Rs2.97, HSD -Rs32.63). Logged as impact 2 (minor, routine small daily adjustment) - much smaller magnitude than the prior day's sharp diesel cut, per desk criteria Rule 10.

news.headline: SBP designates UBL, HBL, NBP as D-SIBs for 2026
news.summary: The State Bank of Pakistan designated United Bank Limited (UBL), Habib Bank Limited (HBL) and National Bank of Pakistan (NBP) as Domestic Systemically Important Banks (D-SIBs) for 2026, requiring additional CET-1 capital buffers, per Mettis Global. Same three banks were designated D-SIBs in 2024 and 2025 (per prior Business Recorder / Mettis Global reporting); no bucket/buffer-percentage figure disclosed in the source reviewed this cycle. Logged as impact 4 (regulatory action, per desk criteria Rule 10) despite the recurring annual nature of the exercise, since it imposes a real capital requirement.

General market-structure statistic, no individual ticker read-through disclosed. Logged as impact 2 (minor, informational sector item).

news.summary: The State Bank of Pakistan introduced Shariah-compliant terminology alternatives across banking regulations as part of its Vision 2028 framework alignment, per Mettis Global. No effective date or bank-specific compliance requirement disclosed. Logged as impact 1 (routine/administrative).
